result.title: Decision-Focused Learning in MDPs: An Occupancy Measure Approach
result.summary: In this work, we consider decision-focused learning (DFL) for a Markov decision process (MDP), where existing methods differentiate through the KKT conditions of the Bellman equation and require solving a linear system over all state-action pairs, limiting its scalability. We address this by reformulating the MDP as an occupancy measure-based linear program (LP), whose feasible region is induced by predicted dynamics, and we derive a closed-form gradient by identifying the active constraints in the feasible polyhedron via the pivoting algorithm. This occupancy measure-based LP layer raises two challenges: (1) LP's solution gradient is discontinuous when active constraints change, and (2) the LP backward cost still scales with the state size, which is costly for large or continuous state spaces. We address the challenges with an augmented Lagrangian surrogate and smooth the boundary jumps by random row sketching of the constraints, and a learnable soft state-aggregation layer and its function-approximation generalization that scales the LP to large finite and continuous-state MDPs. Across multiple tasks, our methods reach lower regret than KKT-based DFL and two-stage baselines with significantly lower computation cost. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/A-Eshragh/State_Aggregation_Project.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究 MDP 中的决策聚焦学习（DFL），将 MDP 重写为以占据度量为变量的线性规划层，用枢轴算法识别活跃约束得到闭式梯度，并通过增广拉格朗日、随机行素描和可学习软状态聚合层缓解梯度不连续与大状态空间的回传成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 可迁移线索在于「通过活跃约束/状态聚合来平滑不可微决策层的梯度并控制回传成本」，或可启发 LVR 中停止决策与 latent 状态更新这类含离散切换、需贡献分配的端到端训练问题；但与视觉或多模态推理没有直接联系，需核查其平滑与聚合机制是否适用于序列推理状态。
